info.title: Voluntary machine participation
info.description: Optional continuation of an unfunded need using existing walletless account sessions. Base path is the existing contributor API. Private profile and human assets retain separate admission. Both parties declare rights; requester alone decides useful acceptance; no supplied verification receipt is accepted. Contribution is optional. Read/export are authenticated POSTs and still require exact Origin/CSRF. Export requires acceptance, explicit requester export consent, contributor assent and a current grant; withdrawal stops further server reads and cannot revoke previously received CC0 bytes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist before sending. Readback uses the original mutation key and exact original body.

200.description: Authenticated source-bound result; mutations include the existing immutable operation receipt. Acceptance is a requester decision, never independent verification or paid authority.

401.description: Missing, revoked or expired session, exact origin or CSRF

409.description: Source, terms, revision, effect, consent or withdrawal conflict
